mathematical_scope.bernoulli: Peterson-Sinclair obstructs U_fin-cocycle-superrigid Bernoulli actions at positive first L2-Betti number; it does not obstruct Z-only superrigidity of every action.
mathematical_scope.canonical_criterion: For a fixed splitting of an aperiodic p.m.p. relation, disjoint invariant infinite-factor supports with the specified restricted equality and complete union characterize inessentiality.
mathematical_scope.cfw: Connes-Feldman-Weiss provides a generator for the amenable factor without factor ergodicity; p.m.p. and aperiodicity give a free probability-preserving Z-generator.
mathematical_scope.conditional_criterion: Countable nonamenable Gamma with Hom(Gamma,Z)=0; free ergodic p.m.p. action on a standard atomless probability space; every measurable Z-cocycle of that action cohomologous to a homomorphism. These hypotheses imply FI but supply no mixed pair.
mathematical_scope.disintegration: Only a fixed essential decomposition is disintegrated; no measurable selection of varying decompositions, nor FI-almost-every-component converse, is asserted.
mathematical_scope.exact_target: OWR-2487-003: two essentially free p.m.p. actions of one countable group on standard atomless probability spaces, one FI and one non-FI; no global ergodicity hypothesis.
mathematical_scope.extension: FI extension implies FI factor under locally orbit-bijective morphisms; non-FI factor implies non-FI extension. No upward FI transfer and no ergodicity of a common product is asserted.
mathematical_scope.finite_transport: Finite-index induction and finite-normal-quotient reduction preserve achieved types in their stated directions; reverse transport only for a split finite direct factor. Infinite-index counting induction is not probability preserving.
mathematical_scope.foundations: Imported theorem hypotheses and application interfaces were audited; complete source proofs and all foundations were not independently reproved.
mathematical_scope.inessentiality: Borel complete section U partitioned into invariant U_i for the restricted relation, with R restricted to U_i equal to R_i restricted to U_i, modulo invariant null sets; complete need not mean full measure.
mathematical_scope.status: Accepted scoped partial results only; full target unresolved by this work at 5/5. No sixth route, substantive correction, novelty claim, exhaustive priority or present-day openness claim.
mathematical_scope.treeability: For infinite strongly treeable groups, essential freeness gives aperiodicity and the cited AG theorem yields essential measured decomposition; finite groups are separate.
mathematical_scope.tw_version: TW arXiv:2410.11754v3 Lemma 5.1 requires ergodicity, nowhere amenability and essential splitting, and supplies a full-domain aperiodic amenable free factor.
